title: Instagram Reel and Image Carousel Publishing

notes: Repairs the existing publishing execution gap where PostgreSQL worker jobs currently hydrate mediaUrls as an empty list, preventing real Instagram media dispatch.
Adds explicit Reel publishing and image-carousel publishing to the existing deterministic Instagram Professional adapter; no unrestricted agent behavior is introduced.
Persists typed public media descriptors and bounded Instagram publishing options with approved content lineage, existing credential references and existing human approval requirements.
Instagram OAuth, Insights, mixed video carousels, media generation/rendering, autonomous publishing, release and production enablement remain outside VS-15.

approvals.rationale: After approving VS-14 certification and merge, Sazid Khan explicitly instructed 'go next'. The previously stated next bounded capability was Reels + Carousel publishing. VS-15 narrows that continuation to Instagram Reels, image carousels and the required end-to-end media binding path.

Existing FR-13/FR-15, credential isolation, deterministic publishing, human approval, retry/unknown-outcome rules and provider-adapter boundaries already govern this extension. No autonomy or credential policy change is introduced.
Authorized continuation into the next planned implementation slice. Runtime work is restricted to the approved Reel/image-carousel publishing and media-binding scope under PES/Loop + Superpowers/TDD.
Exact-SHA human certification remains required after implementation, tests and security/CI gates pass.
VS-15 implementation approval does not authorize release or deployment.
VS-15 implementation approval does not authorize production enablement or autonomous publishing.

evidence: Red TDD head 37063a25092836da1b0017e63812cfc375a25b11 defines domain media-shape/capability rules, Postgres media hydration and deterministic Meta Reel/carousel provider behavior before runtime implementation.
